title: Water rights markets fail to price scarcity in Mediterranean Chile: data and analysis code
description: Data and reproducible analysis pipeline for a study of whether water rights prices carry a hydrological scarcity signal in Mediterranean Chile. Includes construction of the Standardized Precipitation Index from the 1979-2020 record, the k-nearest-neighbour spatial weight matrix, maximum likelihood estimation of a dynamic spatial Durbin model, the LeSage and Pace effects decomposition, and Monte Carlo scenario projection under SSP1-2.6 and SSP5-8.5.
